leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Configure a Node.js application to use cookie-based sessions with a secure session store.
Initialize session middleware with essential security options like HTTP-only flags and same-site policies.
Manipulate session data to store and retrieve user-specific information across requests.
Apply secure cookie attributes to protect against common web vulnerabilities like XSS and CSRF.
Integrate session validation logic to control access to protected routes based on session state.
Construct a logout handler that properly destroys the session and clears the client-side cookie.
